mathematical_contract.slice_factor: For one cubic tensor axis x and retained slice coordinate y, a proposed factor has the form u0+u1*y+x*(v0+v1*y). Three exact specialized roots make a homogeneous three-by-four system; signed maximal minors recover its one-dimensional nullspace when the rank is three.
mathematical_contract.constant_root_fallback: When all three exact specialized roots agree and every maximal minor vanishes, x-root is proposed as a constant bilinear factor. Any other rank-deficient sample set makes no claim.
mathematical_contract.rational_roots: The bounded rational-root theorem proposes exact roots only. Every extracted factor is divided out exactly; the first irreducible or unsupported remainder terminates discovery without invalidating already proved factors.
mathematical_contract.specialization_authority: Four rational specializations at 0, 1, -1, and 2 only propose slice factors. All four choose three triples are tried, and Hypersolve exact bivariate division is the sole authority for accepting a slice divisor.
mathematical_contract.specialization_content: Projective root reconstruction can omit content depending only on the retained variable. Exact coefficient GCD, exact rational roots, and exact multiply/divide replay reattach only content that is itself a proved divisor.
mathematical_contract.lift: The other retained coordinate is treated as a lift. The highest-degree slice and the constant and first Taylor slices after translation at anchors 1, 0, -1, and 2 recover a candidate factor and its relative scale. Both coordinate orientations are attempted.
mathematical_contract.full_division_authority: A lifted candidate is normalized and accepted only when it divides the complete original trivariate tensor exactly. Specializations, roots, minors, and scale samples never assert a global factor by themselves.
mathematical_contract.selected_sign: The verified linear factor and quotient enter the single bounded recursive sign authority. A selected zero factor proves the complete product zero; decided nonzero signs multiply exactly.
mathematical_contract.resource_bound: Dimensions are checked and all bivariate products and reconstructed tensors retain the existing 16384-control ceiling. The recursive split budget remains two: one verified linear factor followed by its quadratic quotient.
mathematical_contract.policy: A supportable rational square-free cubic factorization is Certified under STRICT and APPROXIMATE_512 without terminal consumption. The quartic control remains Predicate uncertainty in STRICT and returns Zero only after APPROXIMATE_512 records Approximate512Consumed.
mathematical_contract.failure: Missing exact rational roots, rank deficiency without a constant root, unresolved exact signs, failed GCD or division, degenerate lift slices, unavailable nonzero relative scale, resource overflow, unsupported coefficient towers, or failed full-tensor division make no exact claim and fall through to the shared policy terminal. No tolerance, sampled positive assertion, compatibility shim, or second Boolean engine is introduced.

capability.comparison_revision: The square-free product of one selected-zero coupled multi-affine factor and two distinct coupled cofactors was unsupported. STRICT returned Predicate uncertainty and APPROXIMATE_512 consumed its terminal.
capability.source_revision: A rational multi-affine factor is reconstructed from exact slice roots, lifted across the third coordinate, proved by exact full-tensor division, and recursively signed with its quadratic quotient.
capability.certified_fixture: The formerly terminal square-free-cubic rational three-field fixture returns Certified Zero under STRICT and APPROXIMATE_512; neither policy consumes the approximate terminal.
capability.differential_factor_coverage: Three distinct dense multi-affine factors reconstruct on every axis; a single rational factor is recovered from an irreducible quadratic cofactor on every axis; retained-variable and highest-lift-slice content are preserved; an unfactored cubic is rejected.
capability.remaining_policy_control: Multiplying the exact cubic fixture by another positive coupled factor makes every axis quartic. The bounded package deliberately declines it; STRICT remains explicitly uncertain and APPROXIMATE_512 returns Zero only with Approximate512Consumed.
capability.remaining_exactness_boundary: Recover bounded quartic factors or construct another bounded exact relation only after axis content, linear resultant, binary selected-root, quadratic, repeated-cubic, and rational square-free-cubic paths fail.
